text.text_excerpt: I have heard about this place having the best fried chicken in the city. SO I came in and ordered some. I had some sweet potato fries while I waited, and I got my chicken to go. it was crispy and crunchy, tasty and simple. I should have asked if they do spicy. either way it was impressive. she even said to not close the bag too tight to ruin the crisp on the chicken. everyone in here looks happy, and joyful. the service was quick, and she was very helpful with my order. I want to come back now and eat there with the hubby. maybe a few drinks, or beyond. its all good to me.

Order some of their fried chicken to go. Amazing! Crispy and juicy! Wonderful mashed potatoes and Debris gravy. The corn On the cob was bland and watery but the rest of the order was Incredible. Typically we eat at the restaurant but did a To go order this time and the food was still perfect.

Went today with my brother, it's been well over a year since the last time I went because I'm never in that area but man after today I'm going to try and be in that area more! Had the Chicken and Rib Platter with mashed potatoes, corn and rolls at Dixie Chicken and Ribs! Soooooo good!!! The ribs were so tender and the chicken was seasoned very well. Staff was very friendly and got to us very quickly after we were seated. Nice little bar area with 2 video poker machines separate from main dining room. Perfect place to go eat for a family night out. My brother had the friend chicken and it did not disappoint either! Can't wait to go back!
